svg.aria-label: How Korext fits together: seven open standards (ai-attestation, ai-license, supply-chain-attestation, ai-incident-registry, ai-code-radar, ai-regression-database, commit-carbon) feed the Korext Platform, which checks AI generated code against 72 policy packs and 532 rules in 13 languages and signs a proof bundle for every scan, and enforce-action, which scans every pull request and fails the check on critical or high severity violations.
